Additionally, Naaman's servants openly give him counsel and advice (וַיִּגְּשׁוּ עֲבָדָיו וַיְדַבְּרוּ אֵלָיו). The narrative shows multiple characters freely expressing their perspectives, opinions, and concerns without any indication of discouragement.
